name: Product Recommendation Quiz by QuizyPilot
author: quizypilotquizbuilder

sections.description:
QuizyPilot builds product-recommendation quizzes that ask shoppers a few questions and send them to the products that actually fit. This plugin connects your WooCommerce store to your QuizyPilot account and gives you a shortcode for each quiz.

You build and design quizzes in the QuizyPilot dashboard, where there is room for the editor, the product mapping and the analytics. The plugin does the part that has to live on your site: the connection, and putting a quiz on a page.

What it does

  • Connects your store so QuizyPilot can read your product catalog
  • Lists your quizzes with a ready-to-paste shortcode for each one
  • Renders a quiz anywhere shortcodes work — pages, posts, the block editor, most page builders

What you need

  • A QuizyPilot account (you can create one during the connection)
  • WooCommerce, active
  • HTTPS on wp-admin — the connection step sends a one-time code back to your site and will not send it over plain HTTP

Usage

Paste the shortcode from the settings screen:

[quizypilot embed="YOUR_EMBED_ID"]

Reserve a different amount of vertical space while the quiz loads:

[quizypilot embed="YOUR_EMBED_ID" height="600"]

The quiz resizes itself to its real content once it loads, so height only affects the placeholder.

External services

This plugin connects to QuizyPilot (https://quizypilot.com), which is required for it to work.

What is sent and when

  • When you click Connect: your store URL and the address of this settings screen, so QuizyPilot can start the WooCommerce authorization and send you back afterwards.
  • When you complete the connection: the one-time code from the return URL, exchanged for a site access token.
  • When the settings screen loads: the site access token, to fetch your quizzes, your plan usage and your quizzes’ statistics for the last 30 days. The plugin version is sent with every request.
  • When you deactivate the plugin: the site access token, to disconnect the store.
  • When you click Open dashboard and sign-in from WordPress is enabled: the site access token, to request a single-use 60-second link that signs you in.

When a page containing the shortcode is viewed, the visitor’s browser loads the quiz loader script (https://app.quizypilot.com/embed.js) and the quiz itself from QuizyPilot. While the visitor takes the quiz, QuizyPilot receives their answers, any details they choose to enter (such as name or email), the page address and referrer, and any UTM campaign parameters in that address. Nothing is sent until the page with the quiz is viewed.

  • Terms: https://quizypilot.com/terms
  • Privacy policy: https://quizypilot.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Go to WooCommerce → QuizyPilot.
  3. Click Connect to QuizyPilot. You will approve API access on your own site, then land back here.
  4. Copy the shortcode next to any quiz and paste it into a page.
sections.faq:
Where do I get the embed id?

You do not need to look it up. The settings screen lists every quiz with its full shortcode and a Copy button.

A quiz shows “No embed yet”. What does that mean?

A quiz and an embed are separate things in QuizyPilot — one quiz can be embedded in several places with different settings. Create an embed for that quiz in the dashboard and it will appear here.

What does the plugin store on my site?

One access token for your store, plus the store URL, the connection date, and a five-minute cache of your quiz list. Deactivating the plugin revokes the token and disconnects the store; deleting the plugin removes everything it stored.

Does the plugin send my customer data to QuizyPilot?

The plugin itself sends nothing but the requests described above. QuizyPilot reads your product catalog through the WooCommerce API keys you approve during the connection, and collects quiz answers from shoppers who take a quiz. See the QuizyPilot privacy policy for what happens to that data.

Will my embedded quizzes break if I deactivate WooCommerce?

No. Rendering a quiz needs nothing from WooCommerce. Only connecting the store does, because the API keys come from WooCommerce’s own authorization endpoint.
sections.changelog:
3.0.4

  • Shorter name: “Product Recommendation Quiz by QuizyPilot”.

3.0.3

  • Renamed to “QuizyPilot – Product Recommendation Quiz for WooCommerce” so merchants searching for a product recommendation quiz can find it.

3.0.2

  • Tidied the footer, and fixed Disconnect rendering as a blue link rather than a quiet one.

3.0.1

  • Fixed the hero pushing its artwork onto a second line.
  • Uses the QuizyPilot logo instead of a placeholder mark.

3.0.0

  • Rebuilt the dashboard: headline counters with a 30-day trend, a wider quiz table showing views, completions and leads per quiz, and shortcuts into the QuizyPilot dashboard.
  • Disconnect now lives quietly in the footer.

2.2.0

  • Simplified the connect screen: five feature cards, and Getting started now runs the full width with its steps side by side.

2.1.2

  • Added the connect screen artwork.

2.1.1

  • Fixed a stray “F512” showing next to the secure-connection note on the connect screen.

2.1.0

  • Redesigned the connect screen: what the plugin does, how to get started, and one clear action.

2.0.1

  • Opening the dashboard from WordPress now works by default — no setting to tick while connecting.

2.0.0

  • Rebuilt the screen as a proper dashboard: plan and usage, all-time counters, and a fuller quiz table with status, responses and created date.
  • One API call now loads everything, so the page is quicker as well as richer.
  • Redesigned the connect screen to match.

1.3.0

  • The settings screen now paints instantly and loads your quizzes in the background, with a loading skeleton instead of a frozen page.
  • Refresh updates the list in place — no page reload.
  • Wider layout, so the quiz table uses the full admin width.
  • Clearer empty and error states, with a retry.

1.2.0

  • Optional: open the QuizyPilot dashboard from WordPress without signing in again. Off unless you enable it while connecting, and the setting is stored on your QuizyPilot account rather than on this site.
  • The settings screen now shows whether that sign-in is enabled.

1.1.0

  • Redesigned the settings screen around WordPress’s own admin patterns.
  • Quiz list now shows a count, an “Edit in dashboard” link per quiz, and a collapsible “How do I put a quiz on a page?” guide.
  • Refresh moved next to the quiz list instead of below it.
  • Fixed the “Create one” link for a quiz with no embed — it pointed at a dashboard route that does not exist.
  • Embed names are only shown when a quiz has more than one embed.

1.0.1

  • The settings screen now shows which QuizyPilot account the store is connected to.

1.0.0

  • First release: connect a store, list quizzes, embed with a shortcode.
